name: Hypnosis
overview: Scripture warns believers against seeking guidance from occult practices, including those involving familiar spirits or wizards, as these defile and lead away from God's holiness (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:9). Trusting in human methods or powers, such as hypnosis, is discouraged in favor of placing confidence solely in the LORD (Psalms 118:8). The heart must be guarded diligently because it directs life’s course (Proverbs 4:23), and yielding oneself to any form of control other than obedience to God can lead to spiritual bondage (Romans 6:16). The believer’s struggle with the flesh underscores the need for reliance on God’s strength rather than human techniques to overcome sin and live righteously (Romans 7:18).
